profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Dev.XYZ
profile.summary:
Full-stack developer with strong foundations, experience with building fully-functional websites from mockup to deployment. Quick to adapt with keen eye for detail and yearning for learning new technologies.
JavaScript (React.js, Redux, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js), PHP (8+, Laravel, CodeIgniter), Tailwind.css, Responsive Design, React Native, Google Firebase, Google Analytics, Google Ads, APIs, SQL, mongoDB, GIT

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
- Built from scratch and deployed multiple websites and web apps for large clients including Ajinomoto Foods and Kia.
- Developed and hard-coded software solutions for in-house development team.
- Built and optimized MySQL databases, as well as coding the admin sites for managing DB for non-devs.
- Led projects ranging from simple landing sites, email templating, customizing WordPress and Magento Child Themes, turning websites responsive and cross-browser compatible

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Deployed multiple full-stack web apps under modern guidelines, MVC frameworks, secure and authenticated systems.
- Worked on various team projects to garner the experience of a corporate development team.

positions.title: Localization Associate
positions.description:
- Conducted localization and quality assurance for top mobile games for global consumers in the iOS and Google Store.
- Gained deep understanding of profitability of video game producers & tech industry,  trends for variety of markets, and analyzed what consumers seek in each market. 
- Gained efficiency, accuracy, and creativity in a fast-paced environment.
- Analyzed competitor trends, weaknesses, and strengths to learn adaptability necessary to survive in tech industry.

positions.title: Localization Specialist (Contractor)
positions.description:
- Conducted frame-by-frame translations from Korean-to-English for feature documentary ‘Legends Rising’.
- Worked directly with producer and editor; learning professional production and editing procedures from media giant.
- Helped create and refine translation and subtitle-editing software, leading to much more efficiency and streamlined process.

positions.title: Global Marketing Intern
positions.description:
- Extensive research of major global markets of food ingredients and commodities.
- Analyzing and organizing raw numerical and tabular data into easily presentable media.
- Accounting work related to financial statement analysis, performance outlook of global leaders in the industry.
- Presented "Alternative Protein in Latin America", an individual market study project, to Global Marketing Divison.
- Extensive usage of Excel, PowerPoint, and Google search engine.
- Learned to be productive in a team environment, as well as to be independent and intuitive on assigned projects.

projects.title: MovieApp
projects.description:
MovieLibrary is currently a side-project, fun little web app that I've built to test some APIs and React.js rendering.

The ultimate goal of this application is to become a social networking service (SNS) for movie lovers. In the prototype phase of my app, you can search and query for movies from an online database, and you'll get back a JSON data of all different types of information about that movie.

You'll see these movie covers updating in real time in response to the search terms.

Each user has his or her own little library, which stores movies that you've already watched. The ultimate goal is to acquire points and achieve milestones based on what movies you've watched, and hopefully later on when we have more users, I'll implement a little 'leaderboards' option for competitive movie-binge.

Of course, all of my web-apps are mobile-friendly, although they are not native apps built with React Native.
